summary: Prepare the internal request-aware agent review answer predicate

replay.detail: The dormant pure predicate consumes caller-owned canonical policy snapshots; no answer fold or append path calls it.

schema.detail: No accepted wire changes; both public parsers still reject agent-review.

rules.detail: Internal checks require the exact resolved reviewer, independent responsibility, request/operation/revision/definition/attempt binding, approved/pass or rejected/fail, a nonblank rejection reason and the existing evidence validator. Human delegation cannot satisfy this predicate.

compatibility.detail: No production agent review caller or GateSpec variant is enabled. Human review behavior is unchanged.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery is required.
